It has the poles, the hanging cloths in rows 32-41, a dark recess and the goods on the ground in rows 48-61. styleAnswer.evidence: The measured facts put the candidate level with the stall and well references: 17 visible tones per full tile against 17 for the cheese stall and 20 for the roofed well, and 0% near-flat coverage (the stall has 13%). Only 0% of its dark edge pixels are near-neutral, so the outlines carry a tint rather than being a black sticker line. By eye, the tarp roof is built from striped orange and green strips with several lightness steps each, plus sag shading, seams and patches. The hanging cloths in pink, yellow, blue and white are individually shaded, and the rugs and bundles below have their own highlights and shadows. The piece is larger and busier than the cheese stall, with no large flat areas. A careful artist would accept it next to the references.
